title: uiState is not updated properly after calling setUiState
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

After calling manually `setUiState` from my custom menu component, the uiState object is not reflecting the change in the onStateChange event listener in the middleware.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/svelte-forked-13ymr

On the above sandbox click on an entry in the custom menu. Check the console output (or URL params) to see the value of uiState object which is not reflecting the latest `setUiState` call. Actually it's always reflecting the previous value set.
